item.title: factory_boy vs FactoryBot vs Fishery in 2026: Which Fixture Factory Wins?
item.description: Your test suite takes 40 seconds to boot and 31 of those seconds are spent building objects you do not care about. Someone on the team suggests “just use fixtures”, someone else says fixtures are the reason the suite is unmaintainable, and you end up reading three README files that all promise the same thing: declarative test data.
